evidences.evidence_context: Recent research indicates that non-acoustic hardware, such as motion sensors [153, 32, 34, 39, 209, 80], actuators [151, 192, 138], communication devices [255, 240, 271, 133, 254], storage devices [125], radars [52, 75, 268, 238, 288, 279, 54], cameras [63, 141], and instruments [169, 168, 286, 195], can create a side channel to eavesdrop the speech generated by humans or loudspeakers.
